head: ġyr1 (< Arab. ġwr cf. Wehr 931: einfallen, einsinken)

examples.turoyo: lo=k-əḏʕi mən-yo qay lə=g-zobəṭ u=talgo k-əmmi i=walaye ġayiro u=talgo lə=g-zobəṭ aʕla
examples.translation: People did not know what it was, why snow would not stay. Some said: “The town is sunken, (that is why) the snow would not stay” 77/9;
examples.raw: lo=k-əḏʕi mən-yo qay lə=g-zobəṭ u=talgo k-əmmi i=walaye ġayiro u=talgo lə=g-zobəṭ aʕla ‘People did not know what it was, why snow would not stay. Some said: “The town is sunken, (that is why) the snow would not stay” 77/9;

examples.turoyo: w-i=walaye d-u=Fīl-aṯe b-Ṭuro d-aʕ=ʕabode-yo (…) uʕdo dukṯe d-i=walaye ġayərto-yo
examples.translation: And this town of Fil is (situated) at the Mountain of Worshippers (…). Nowadays the (former) site of the town is under the earth’s surface
examples.raw: w-i=walaye d-u=Fīl-aṯe b-Ṭuro d-aʕ=ʕabode-yo (…) uʕdo dukṯe d-i=walaye ġayərto-yo ‘And this town of Fil is (situated) at the Mountain of Worshippers (…). Nowadays the (former) site of the town is under the earth’s surface’ 77/6;
